ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the fluke area, punctuated by high-intensity (white/light-grey) localized pixel clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black substrate; high-intensity white vertical patch at the central-inferior insertion point (peduncle base); discrete circular white spots (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed randomly; concentrated high-intensity tan/white textural cluster at the distal right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped vertex with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth relative to the horizontal span of the fluke is roughly 1:7.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with non-uniform amplitude; prominent sharp peaks (15-20 pixel height) visible on the right lobe distal margin; high frequency micro-serrations across the mid-sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves extending from the median notch to the tips, terminating in sharp, upwardly angled distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white clusters (approx. 12-15 discrete instances) distributed across both lobes, most concentrated in the upper-mid sections.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions; prominent set of 3-4 parallel vertical lines on the right lobe and intersecting diagonal lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme textural deformation and high-intensity pixel clustering at both distal tips, indicating calcified attachment or scarring; right tip shows significant irregular thickening and loss of smooth linear boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical white linear streak extending from the central fluke insertion point upwards into the median notch area.
